The <b>Farsight</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)|item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is functionally equivalent to the [[World Sense]] ability of <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i> once activated in the [[Bellhome]].

== Use ==
Displays current [[Completion (Silksong)|completion]] percentage in the inventory and on the [[Save Data (Silksong)|save profile]] in the main menu. Also shows the number of enemies encountered and required in the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]], and number of [[Tools]] and [[Silk Skills]] obtained.

Anything that is yet to be collected, whether it is a Tool, Silk Skill, Hunter's Journal entry, or [[Materium]] entry, is shown as a small grey circle.

Farsight itself is not a requirement for 100% completion. The completion percentage always shows up after the credit screen if the [[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 4: Sister of the Void|Sister of the Void]] ending is completed, regardless of whether Farsight is installed.

== How to Acquire ==
Found in [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]], in the upper east passage of [[The Abyss (Silksong)|Weavenest Absolom]]. The item must be constructed in the Bellhome in [[Bellhart]] before it can be used.
